start: A phone with MettleUp set up (a profile and workouts), app fully closed

steps.action: Open MettleUp from the home screen
user_sees: The splash, then the app on the member's own workouts (Workout tab)
must_not: The welcome screen shown over real training
A "demo data" badge on real data

start: Fresh install, no profile on this phone

steps.action: Open MettleUp for the first time
user_sees: Welcome titled 'Get stronger every week'
'Log every set at the gym. See what you lifted the previous time.'
must_not: Any workouts or a profile that the member did not make
An error screen on a healthy empty phone

start: A phone whose storage is full, with real workouts on it

steps.action: Open MettleUp
user_sees: Title 'Your phone's storage is full'
'Your phone's storage is full. Free some space, then tap Try again.'
Buttons 'Try again' and 'Save my data file', and 'Details'
must_not: The welcome screen (a first run over real training)
Any workout deleted or changed

steps.action: Free some space, tap Try again twice quickly
user_sees: The button shows it is working, then the app opens on the member's own workouts
must_not: Two start-ups running at once
The same failure shown again because the first failed open was remembered

start: A phone where the member tapped "Load demo data" earlier, app closed

steps.action: Open MettleUp
user_sees: The app opens on the demo, still marked as demo data
must_not: The demo treated as the member's real data (no demo badge)

steps.action: Remove the demo data, close and reopen the app
user_sees: The welcome screen (no profile is left)
must_not: The demo badge left over
The demo person's workouts still shown

start: Any phone, first launch of this version

steps.action: Open MettleUp for the first time on this phone
user_sees: Nothing new on screen; the app notes when it was first opened on this phone
must_not: That time sent to MettleUp or the gym
That time overwritten on a later launch

steps.action: Later, send past workouts to Health Connect
user_sees: By default only workouts started after that first opening are offered
must_not: Workouts from the old ForgeAI app sent a second time by default

start: A pass member's phone, joined to a gym, with a profile

steps.action: Open MettleUp
user_sees: The app opens on the member's own workouts, in the gym's look when the gym has one
must_not: The welcome screen
The gym link lost by the start-up

start: Same phone, the first database read fails

steps.action: Open MettleUp
user_sees: Title 'MettleUp could not start'
'MettleUp couldn't read your data. Your workouts are still on this phone. Tap Try again.'
must_not: The welcome screen (a first run over real training)
The gym link or workouts removed

start: Same phone, on the error screen after a failed open

steps.action: Tap Try again after the cause has gone
user_sees: The app opens on the member's own workouts
must_not: The old failed open handed back again, so Try again can never work

start: Same phone on the error screen

steps.action: Tap 'Save my data file'
user_sees: 'Keep this file somewhere safe. If you need help, send it to your gym, who can pass it to MettleUp to open.'
must_not: The file sent anywhere by itself
The file sent without the member choosing where

start: App process starts on any phone

steps.action: Open the database file forgeai.db and switch on its write-ahead log and foreign keys
user_sees: Nothing on screen yet (the splash)
must_not: A second database handle opened by a parallel start

steps.action: Run the table setup and note the schema version and, only if absent, the first-open time
user_sees: The app goes on to read whether a profile exists
must_not: The first-open time overwritten
Screens reading the database before this finishes

start: An upgrade step fails (a column cannot be added)

steps.action: The table setup throws inside its transaction
user_sees: The member sees 'MettleUp could not start' and 'MettleUp couldn't finish updating your data. Your workouts are still on this phone. Tap Try again.'
must_not: The app opening on a half-upgraded database
The open handle left open

start: A start-up that failed once

steps.action: The member taps Try again
user_sees: A fresh open of the database is tried
must_not: The earlier failed attempt remembered and handed back

steps.action: The app is opened again on a later day
user_sees: The first-open time stays as it was
must_not: The first-open time moved to today
